DomainEventOutbox.Comment: Issue #1535 Phase B — OutboxOnly mode is the target steady state. Inline MediatR.Publish inside SaveChangesAsync is OFF; the DomainEventOutboxProcessor BackgroundService is the SOLE dispatcher. This closes the original #1535 race: a rolled-back outer transaction never causes side-effects to escape. Rollback path: flip back to Hybrid and redeploy — the Phase A behaviour resumes immediately (outbox rows continue to flow + inline Publish fires for all events).
